en:
<CLT=cltMIND>We decided to hang out
in the AV room.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like we're the only ones here...
What should we do?
Watch a comedy movie
Watch a horror movie
Watch an action movie

Movies like this are great for 
turning your mood around.

When you're down, all you gotta do is
let out a laugh and everything's good!

If you're down all the time, then your
dreams might get away from you!
L-Like I'd watch something so uncool.

What's so fun about watching 
fake g-g-ghosts!?

Don't get me wrong!
I'm not s-scared or anything!

Action movies are fun cuz you don't 
have to think too hard to enjoy them.

And there's a bunch of 'em that use 
the universe as their stage!

Alright! I'm gonna tell you all 
about my favorites!
You ready to take notes!?

<CLT=cltMIND>I wonder what's wrong?
Kaito looks deep in thought...
(Damn it...)
<CLT=cltMIND>Huh?
<CLT=cltMIND>That voice just now. Is that...?
<CLT=cltMIND>Is that Kaito's inner thoughts...?
